items.title: Larry Ridley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 10, 2003
items.q: And the Montgomery brothers, Wes, Buddy and Monk were there. And Monk befriended me

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Toronto at the IAJE convention. I’m extremely pleased to have Larry Ridley with me today.

You have had a marvelous career in different parts of the music. And I’m wondering if when you were a boy or a young man at what point did you set your career path? Is it possible — was it that definite of a time?
